med-sc-01-c2.text: Europeana. Book Censorship and Banned Books: The Index Librorum Prohibitorum. Europeana (blog).
med-sc-01-c2.quote: The first official Roman Index of banned books was published in 1559 under Pope Paul IV.
med-sc-01-c2.claim: The most famous instrument is the Roman Catholic Church's Index Librorum Prohibitorum, first published in 1559 by Pope Paul IV.
